title: Readiness probe targets the wrong port
description: A Kubernetes workload listens on 8080 while its readiness probe targets 9090.

files.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          command: ["app", "--listen=:8080"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 9090

candidates.title: Readiness probe cannot reach the configured listener

evidence.execution_path: The container starts its declared listener on 8080 while kubelet probes the same container on 9090
evidence.violated_invariant: The readiness probe must target a port served by the workload
evidence.falsifier_checked: The complete container declaration exposes only port 8080 and declares no listener or sidecar on 9090

candidates.impact: New pods remain unready, preventing traffic and potentially blocking the rollout.
candidates.recommendation: Point the readiness probe at the actual readiness listener and verify its path.

verdicts.reason: The manifest itself establishes incompatible listener and readiness-probe ports.
